sectionOrder: Tracks at the Edge of the World

item.name: Vogita
item.cardSummary: Vogita is a boss entry for Planet Namak Act 1 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: It's amazing how every time you open your mouth, you manage to prove you're an idiot. Are you ready now to witness a power not seen for thousands of years?
item.description: Vogita, the Prince of all Saiyans, was once a sought-out enemy but is now an ally, helping the Super Warriors against Friezo's villainous scheme.

item.name: Doria
item.cardSummary: Doria is a boss entry for Planet Namak Act 2 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed mutator Overshield makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Not bad... I let my guard down, though. Don't you dare mock me! Are you ready to get pulverized?
item.description: Doria has a rather brash and vulgar demeanor in sharp contrast to the more refined attitude seen in his comrade Argon. He is intelligent but often lets his anger get the best of him.

item.name: Argon (Transformed)
item.cardSummary: Argon (Transformed) is a boss entry for Planet Namak Act 3 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed mutator Overshield makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: If you can't beat me, you'll have no chance against Lord Friezo. My beauty makes me the one true candidate for Emperor of the Universe.
item.description: Argon is an elite warrior who values beauty and his physical appearance above all else. He is considered to be very handsome. Watch out for his second form!

item.name: Giyu
item.cardSummary: Giyu is a boss entry for Planet Namak Act 4 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Summon makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: I am Captain Giyu, a soldier so elite that even crying children fall silent in my presence!
item.description: Unlike his comrades, Giyu is a very calculating and methodical man, preferring a pragmatic approach in battle. He is noted by his subordinates to always research the mission at hand before acting. He is shown to have a very developed understanding of ki and fighting.

item.name: Guldy
item.cardSummary: Guldy is a boss entry for Planet Namak Act 4 with critical danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: It's time for the great Guldy, Gyeh-hee-heh!
item.description: Guldy possesses some psychic abilities, including being able to stop time for as long as he can hold his breath.

item.name: Butter
item.cardSummary: Butter is a boss entry for Planet Namak Act 4 with critical danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: I'm the fastest in the universe!
item.description: Being nicknamed the 'Blue Hurricane', he often performs combo attacks with Jiece.

item.name: Recroom
item.cardSummary: Recroom is a boss entry for Planet Namak Act 4 with critical danger level. Its listed ability Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Recroom Super Fight Bomb!
item.description: He is the most flamboyant member as he is seen striking poses more often in battle than Captain Giyu himself and generally behaving in a deceptively goofy manner.

item.name: Jiece
item.cardSummary: Jiece is a boss entry for Planet Namak Act 4 with critical danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: Got ya mate. This is what you get for messin' with the Giyu!
item.description: Nicknamed the 'Red Magma', he often pairs with Burter for combination attacks.

item.name: Friezo
item.mechanicsSummary: Stun duration: 10s; Targets: 1; Range: Full; Attack time: 12s
item.cardSummary: Friezo is a boss entry for Planet Namak Act 5 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Shall we begin this spectacle of horror? I must say... I am not nearly as impressed with you as I was before.
item.description: With a power level of 530,000, nobody can stand up to this tyrant of maniacal power... or so he thought before arriving on Planet Namak.

item.name: Friezo (Full Power)
item.mechanicsSummary: Transforms: true; Stun duration: 10s; Targets: 2; Range: Full; Attack time: 15s
item.cardSummary: Friezo (Full Power) is a boss entry for Planet Namak Act 6 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Evolution, Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Observe... this time, I'll reduce you to dust, just like I did to that Earthling!
item.description: In an attempt to finish off Vogita and the rest of Planet Namak, Friezo transforms into his Final Form. Being rivaled by a putrid Saiyan has Friezo in a pit of rage. Oh wait, he has another trick up his sleeve!

item.name: Alien Soldier
item.cardSummary: Alien Soldier is a enemy entry for Planet Namak with trivial danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: Armed with a laser gun it barely knows how to use, it thinks Earth is a theme park and humans are annoying tourists.

item.name: Alien Enlist
item.cardSummary: Alien Enlist is a enemy entry for Planet Namak with trivial danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: Armed with a laser cannon and a love for dramatic entrances, it believes the louder the explosion, the better the tactic.

item.name: Alien Elite
item.cardSummary: Alien Elite is a enemy entry for Planet Namak with moderate danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: The crème de la crème of extraterrestrial warriors. Armed with a precision laser, it moves with the grace of a space ballet dancer.

item.name: Alien Cadet
item.cardSummary: Alien Cadet is a enemy entry for Planet Namak with critical danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: Zipping around faster than a caffeinated cheetah, it thinks dodging bullets is a sport.

item.name: Alien General
item.cardSummary: Alien General is a enemy entry for Planet Namak with extreme danger level. Its listed mutator Overshield makes it more than a plain index target.
item.description: The mastermind behind the planet invasion. With a strategic mind sharper than a laser, this alien commands with authority.

item.name: Dodera
item.mechanicsSummary: Stun duration: 10s; Targets: All; Range: Full
item.cardSummary: Dodera is a boss entry for Sand Village Act 1 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Look at these fools. They have no appreciation for art. You have to feel art. And true art... is an EXPLOSION!
item.description: During his partnership with Sosora, Dodera usually showed a cool, and relaxed attitude, never losing his smirk even while fighting an intense battle or when being blamed by his partner. However, his personality seemed to change to some extent after being partnered with Tobi.

item.name: Kimase
item.cardSummary: Kimase is a boss entry for Sand Village Act 2 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability SPA debuff makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: You really have a talent of getting on people's nerves. I suppose I'll toy with you until you remember.
item.description: Kimase loves to fight. He is quite sadistic and demonstrates no hesitation in mutilating his opponents. Despite his aggressive nature, Kimase is very perceptive and keen-minded in battle.

item.name: Itochi
item.mechanicsSummary: Stun duration: 2s; Targets: All; Range: Full
item.cardSummary: Itochi is a boss entry for Sand Village Act 3 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: It's best not to be optimistic and think it's an illusion. The pain is not an illusion. The pain is absolutely no different from reality. How long will your spirit sustain.
item.description: From a young age, Itachi was calm and insightful, showing noticeable maturity for his age and knowledge on how to deal with every situation. He lived at a distance, observing individuals and ideas without getting directly involved so that he could fully understand them.

item.name: Hirko
item.cardSummary: Hirko is a boss entry for Sand Village Act 4 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed mutator Overshield makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: True beauty lies in things that last forever, never rotting or fading.
item.description: Serving as puppet armor, it allowed Sosora to hide inside of it. Sosora also adorned Hirko with the Akatsuki's robes.

item.name: Third Kazekage
item.cardSummary: Third Kazekage is a boss entry for Sand Village Act 5 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: I don't like to wait and I don't like to keep others waiting. So let me make this quick and sweet.
item.description: This is the human puppet created by Sosora from the body of the Third Kazekage. After converting him into a puppet, Sosora gained access to the abilities the Kazekage had while he was alive.

item.name: Sosora (Second Phase)
item.cardSummary: Sosora (Second Phase) is a boss entry for Sand Village Act 6 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Summon makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Give it up... this body feels no pain. If all you do is hit me, your fist is all that will hurt.
item.description: Sosora grew up in a sad and lonely environment due to the absence of parental love. When introduced to the art of puppetry by his grandmother, Chiyo, he grew a little happier.

item.name: Puppet
item.cardSummary: Puppet is a enemy entry for Sand Village with trivial danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: The puppet’s hair is wild and unkempt, adding to its feral appearance, while its body is slightly hunched, suggesting a predatory stance.

item.name: Fast Puppet
item.cardSummary: Fast Puppet is a enemy entry for Sand Village with critical danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: When it moves, the Fast Puppet leaves behind a trail of colorful streaks, making it appear as though it’s teleporting from one spot to another.

item.name: Strong Puppet
item.cardSummary: Strong Puppet is a enemy entry for Sand Village with moderate danger level. Its listed mutator Overshield makes it more than a plain index target.
item.description: Despite its bulk, the puppet can move with surprising agility, using its strength to execute powerful moves and ground-shaking stomps.

item.name: Shinobi Puppet
item.cardSummary: Shinobi Puppet is a enemy entry for Sand Village with critical danger level. Its listed ability Clone/Thrice makes it more than a plain index target.
item.description: The puppet’s limbs are articulated, allowing for fluid movements and dynamic poses, perfect for showcasing martial arts skills or stealthy maneuvers.

item.name: Large Puppet
item.cardSummary: Large Puppet is a enemy entry for Sand Village with extreme danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: Draped in tattered, flowing garments that billow with each movement, the Large Puppet gives the impression of an ancient warrior or a dark sorcerer.

item.name: Dismantled Puppet
item.cardSummary: Dismantled Puppet is a enemy entry for Sand Village with moderate danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: Upon Shinobi Puppet’s death, this dismantled puppet will spawn. Kill it quick, before revives!

item.name: Mace Statue
item.cardSummary: Mace Statue is a boss entry for Double Dungeon Act 1 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: ...Rumble Rumble Rumble.
item.description: The statue's face is chiseled into a fierce grimace, with deep-set eyes that seem to glow with an eerie light when it comes to life. When activated, the Mace Statue emits a deep, rumbling sound, as if the very stone is coming to life.

item.name: Axe Statue
item.mechanicsSummary: Stun duration: 19s; Targets: In Range; Range: 25; Attack time: 30s
item.cardSummary: Axe Statue is a boss entry for Double Dungeon Act 2 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Let..Rumble..Me..Rumble..Axe..Rumble..You..Rumble..A..Rumble..Question.
item.description: The statue's face is stern and imposing, with fierce eyes carved deep into the stone, seemingly watching over its surroundings. When the Axe Statue comes to life, it emits a deep, resonating rumble, as if the very earth trembles at its awakening.

item.name: Sword Statue
item.mechanicsSummary: Stun duration: 19s; Targets: 1; Range: 15; Attack time: 20s
item.cardSummary: Sword Statue is a boss entry for Double Dungeon Act 3, Legend Stage Act 1 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Crack..Boom, Rumble Rumble.
item.description: The statue’s face is regal yet fierce, with chiseled features that express determination and strength. Its piercing gaze seems to follow intruders, and the noble posture exudes an aura of authority.

item.name: Shield Statue
item.cardSummary: Shield Statue is a boss entry for Double Dungeon Act 4 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed mutator Overshield makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Rumble..Must..Rumble..Defend!
item.description: The statue’s face is fierce yet resolute, with deep-set eyes that seem to glow with a protective light. Its broad shoulders convey a sense of unwavering strength, and its powerful limbs are designed for both offense and defense.

item.name: Spear Statue
item.cardSummary: Spear Statue is a boss entry for Double Dungeon Act 5, Legend Stage Act 2 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: I'll pierce right through you! Erm I mean... Rumble Rumble?
item.description: The statue’s face is fierce and focused, with sharp features and deep-set eyes that seem to watch over its territory with unwavering vigilance. Its movements are fluid yet precise, allowing it to launch swift and powerful thrusts with the spear.

item.name: God Statue
item.cardSummary: God Statue is a boss entry for Double Dungeon Act 6, Legend Stage Act 3 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Thou Shall Worship God. Thou Shall Praise God. Thou shall prove thy faith. Those who fail to obey these commandments shall not be spared.
item.description: A giant stone copy of the Absolute, accompanied by glowing red eyes and black sclera. Noted by its sadistic smile, could this really be a god?

item.name: Goblin
item.cardSummary: Goblin is a enemy entry for Double Dungeon with trivial danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: Dressed in tattered, mismatched clothing made from scraps of fabric and leather, the goblin’s outfit is both practical and deceptive. This goblin excels in ambush tactics, often lurking in shadows or behind obstacles.

item.name: Wolfman
item.cardSummary: Wolfman is a enemy entry for Double Dungeon with moderate danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: Draped in tattered clothing that barely contains its powerful form, the Wolfman wears remnants of a once-stylish outfit—now ripped and torn from countless battles.

item.name: Lycan
item.cardSummary: Lycan is a enemy entry for Double Dungeon with critical danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: The Lycan’s face is a terrifying blend of wolf and human features, with a pronounced snout filled with razor-sharp teeth, and piercing, glowing eyes that reflect a predatory intelligence.

item.name: Lizardman
item.cardSummary: Lizardman is a enemy entry for Double Dungeon with moderate danger level. Its listed mutator Overshield makes it more than a plain index target.
item.description: The Lizardman’s jagged head features a prominent jaw filled with sharp teeth, and its piercing yellow eyes have a predatory gleam, capable of seeing in the dark.

item.name: Hobgoblin
item.cardSummary: Hobgoblin is a enemy entry for Double Dungeon with critical danger level. Its listed ability Summon makes it more than a plain index target.
item.description: The Hobgoblin stands at a formidable 5 feet tall, boasting a stocky and muscular build that conveys strength and resilience. Its skin is a deep, earthy blue, marred by scars that tell the tales of countless battles.

item.name: Dogon
item.cardSummary: Dogon is a boss entry for Shibuya Station Act 1 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: My name is not cursed spirit... My name is Dogon. Honomi, Jag-o and Mohato. WE ALL BEAR NAMES
item.description: Dogon was a special grade curse with the dangerous ability to generate and control water. This made him a great threat close to the level of his allies

item.name: Reanimated Tuji
item.mechanicsSummary: Stun duration: 4s; Targets: In Range; Range: 20; Attack time: 24s
item.cardSummary: Reanimated Tuji is a boss entry for Shibuya Station Act 2 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: You guys with all your blessings lost to a monkey like me who can't even use Jujutsu.
item.description: Tuji is an assassin who's garnered the name 'Sorcerer Killer' and spends his time gambling between assignments from shady clients.

item.name: Chaso
item.mechanicsSummary: Stun duration: 2s; Targets: 1; Range: 40; Attack time: 12s
item.cardSummary: Chaso is a boss entry for Shibuya Station Act 3 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: When you get to the other side, be sure to ask for my brothers’ forgiveness.
item.description: Chaso is a half cursed spirit but he doesn't have an inherent desire to attack people and doesn't even harbor any disdain toward jujutsu sorcerers. He's not cruel or vicious.

item.name: Shogamo
item.cardSummary: Shogamo is a boss entry for Shibuya Station Act 4 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Multiple Lives makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Hahaha you had be scared for a moment, I thought died!
item.description: This sorcerer lives his day to day life on luck. Thanks to miracles he remembers, this sorcerer fights without worry.

item.name: Mohato
item.mechanicsSummary: Stun duration: 6s; Targets: 1; Range: 35; Attack time: 18s
item.cardSummary: Mohato is a boss entry for Shibuya Station Act 5 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Tell me, which do you think came first — the soul or the body?
item.description: Born from the inner turmoil and hatred that humans harbor within, this playful cursed spirit only seeks to massacre that from which he originates.

item.name: Transfigured Mohato
item.mechanicsSummary: Stun duration: 8s; Targets: 1; Range: 50; Attack time: 18s
item.cardSummary: Transfigured Mohato is a boss entry for Shibuya Station Act 6 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: I'm the Only Person in This World Who Understands the Composition of Souls.
item.description: Mohato has learned what it means to be a true curse. In light of this discovery Mohato takes on a new form, becoming stronger than ever before.

item.name: Jag-o
item.cardSummary: Jag-o is a boss entry for Shibuya Station Act 1 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Humans are built on lies. Behind every good deed and positive emotion, there's always a catch. But things like hatred and hostility? That's as real as it gets.
item.description: A fiery, volcanic special cursed spirit who believes his kind to be the true form of humanity. Absolutely despises humans for hiding their real nature.

item.name: Sukono
item.mechanicsSummary: Stun duration: 7s; Targets: In Range; Range: Full
item.cardSummary: Sukono is a boss entry for Shibuya Station Act 2 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Stun, DMG Debuff makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Know your place, fool.
item.description: An ancient evil reincarnated into the body of Itaduri. He only seeks to wreak havoc and revels at the thought of fighting formidable adversaries like him.

item.name: Gotoe
item.cardSummary: Gotoe is a boss entry for Shibuya Station Act 3 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: You dare challenge me, a powerful sorcerer compared to a mere monkey like you?
item.description: A renegade sorcerer that became disillusioned with the world, eventually succumbing to his own evil. He now seeks to rid it of all non-sorcerers.

item.name: Cursed Spirit
item.cardSummary: Cursed Spirit is a enemy entry for Shibuya Station with trivial danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: Curse spirit created when being touched by Mohato.

item.name: Tall Cursed Spirit
item.cardSummary: Tall Cursed Spirit is a enemy entry for Shibuya Station with trivial danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: Curse spirit created when being touched by Mohato.

item.name: Lizard Curse
item.cardSummary: Lizard Curse is a enemy entry for Shibuya Station with trivial danger level. Its listed mutator Regen makes it more than a plain index target.
item.description: The lizard curse having an abnormal body structure, allows it to regenerate itself from even the strongest of blows.

item.name: Finger Bearer
item.cardSummary: Finger Bearer is a enemy entry for Shibuya Station with trivial danger level. Its listed mutator Overshield, Regen makes it more than a plain index target.
item.description: Holding one of Sukono's fingers, this curse is nothing but a vessel for Sukono to kill.

item.name: Cricket Curse
item.cardSummary: Cricket Curse is a enemy entry for Shibuya Station with trivial danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: The cricket curse known for it's big stature and praying on humans, this curse poses a huge threat to none sorcerers.

item.name: Transfigured Human
item.cardSummary: Transfigured Human is a enemy entry for Shibuya Station with trivial danger level. Its listed mutator Overshield makes it more than a plain index target.
item.description: A human bearing the unfortunate fate when touched by Mohato.

item.name: Cu Chulainn
item.cardSummary: Cu Chulainn is a boss entry for Underground Church Act 1 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Stun makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Heh, you've got guts facing me here. Let's see if you can dodge my Gae Bolg!
item.description: Ireland's Child of Light, wielding the cursed spear Gae Bolg. His Protection from Arrows and Battle Continuation skills make him an incredibly difficult foe to defeat.

item.name: Heracles
item.cardSummary: Heracles is a boss entry for Underground Church Act 2 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Extra Life makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: ROAAAAAAAR! [The berserker's mighty roar shakes the very foundations of the altar.]
item.description: The greatest hero of Greek mythology, his already immense strength further amplified by the altar's influence. His God Hand noble phantasm grants him twelve lives.

item.name: Medusa
item.cardSummary: Medusa is a boss entry for Underground Church Act 3 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: The rider, riding into combat.
item.description: HORSE RIDAAAAAAAAAAAA

item.name: Kiro
item.cardSummary: Kiro is a boss entry for Underground Church Act 4, Legend Stage Act 2 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: The altar's power flows through me. Let me show you true strength!
item.description: A corrupted warrior whose skills have been enhanced by the altar's dark influence. Their once-noble fighting style has been twisted into something fearsome and unrecognizable.

item.name: Lilia
item.cardSummary: Lilia is a boss entry for Underground Church Act 5 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed mutator Overshield makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Your path ends here. The altar demands nothing less than total victory.
item.description: A mysterious warrior whose true identity remains shrouded in darkness. Her connection to A.W.E. has granted her powers that rival ancient heroes.

item.name: Medea
item.cardSummary: Medea is a boss entry for Underground Church Act 6 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: Such amusing resistance... All contracts shall be rendered null before my blade.
item.description: The Witch of Betrayal from the Argonauts' tale, wielding powerful magecraft from the Age of Gods. Her Rule Breaker noble phantasm can sever any magical contract.

item.name: Archer
item.cardSummary: Archer is a boss entry for Underground Church Act 1 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: I am the bone of my sword... Steel is my body and fire is my blood.
item.description: The Counter Guardian EMIYA, master of projection magecraft and deadly with his twin blades Kanshou and Bakuya. His Reality Marble 'Unlimited Blade Works' contains countless Noble Phantasms.

item.name: Gilgamesh
item.cardSummary: Gilgamesh is a boss entry for Underground Church Act 3 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Deletes Units makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Mongrels! Witness the true might of the King of Heroes! My treasury contains your doom!
item.description: The King of Heroes, possessor of all the world's treasures within his Gate of Babylon. His arrogance is matched only by his overwhelming power.

item.name: Dragon Fang Warrior
item.cardSummary: Dragon Fang Warrior is a enemy entry for Underground Church with trivial danger level. Its listed mutator Ossified makes it more than a plain index target.
item.description: A member of the Dragon Fang warrior clan, trained in close combat. Though individually weak compared to Servants, they fight with coordinated tactics and unwavering loyalty to their cause.

item.name: Dragon Fang Archer
item.cardSummary: Dragon Fang Archer is a enemy entry for Underground Church with trivial danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: Ranged specialist of the Dragon Fang clan. They employ enchanted arrows and take advantage of elevated positions to rain death upon their targets.

item.name: Dragon Fang Beast
item.cardSummary: Dragon Fang Beast is a enemy entry for Underground Church with trivial danger level. Its listed mutator Ossified, Overshield makes it more than a plain index target.
item.description: A monstrous creature bred by the Dragon Fang clan, combining magical enhancement with bestial instincts. Their savage attacks can overwhelm the unprepared.

item.name: Homunculus
item.cardSummary: Homunculus is a enemy entry for Underground Church with trivial danger level. Its listed ability Extra Life and mutator Regen makes it more than a plain index target.
item.description: An artificial human created through alchemy, designed for magical combat. While each one possesses only a fraction of their creator's power, their sheer numbers make them dangerous.

item.name: Shadow Titan
item.cardSummary: Shadow Titan is a enemy entry for Underground Church with trivial danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.description: A massive construct of concentrated darkness, pulled from humanity's primal fears. Its heavy strikes can shatter defensive formations with ease.

item.name: The Visionary
item.cardSummary: The Visionary is a boss entry for Spirit Society Act 1 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed mutator Overshield makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: I want to win. I want to win, I want to win, I want to win! For the first time in my life, I feel a true desire to win against somebody!
item.description: The power of imagination wrapped up in one person, the only way he could lose is if he imagines it.

item.name: The Explosion
item.cardSummary: The Explosion is a boss entry for Spirit Society Act 2 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: The whole point of fighting is that you don't want to die! That you'll be killed if you lose! If you throw your life away in battle, where's the point in winning?!!
item.description: The leader of an all female group of kuinshi's, known for her brutal treatment of her underlings.

item.name: The Superstar
item.cardSummary: The Superstar is a boss entry for Spirit Society Act 3 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: Worry not, Games! A star and his fans are joined at the heart! As long as I live, you will be reborn!
item.description: A masked warrior who's sidekicks cheer makes stronger, seemingly no way to defeat the duo.

item.name: Games
item.cardSummary: Games is a boss entry for Spirit Society Act 3 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: If you take care of that pair who have flashily fallen from the sky like shooting stars, it will make a star out of you too!
item.description: The sidekick of The Superstar, seemingly harmless. Always seen cheering for his idol.

item.name: The Axis
item.cardSummary: The Axis is a boss entry for Spirit Society Act 4 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: An envoy of God knows not despair.
item.description: The very embodiment of light itself, seemingly unable to miss their target.

item.name: The Deathdealing
item.cardSummary: The Deathdealing is a boss entry for Spirit Society Act 5 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: Nope, no good! Dealing with you is just gonna take way too much time. I'd better not bother. I mean if I was gonna make you die, I reckon I'd have to try out way too many different tactics. Sorry, but I'm just awful with that kind of finicky stuff. I like to get things over with in a flash, y'know?
item.description: One of the royal guards, catches his opponents off guard with his aloof personality. By the time they catch on they are already dead.

item.name: The Miracle
item.cardSummary: The Miracle is a boss entry for Spirit Society Act 6, Legend Stage Act 2 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
item.quote: At what point did I say this would be a one-on-one fight? In a fair duel, not even a miracle would allow you to defeat me! Come at me together!
item.description: The heart of the spirit king, able to confront and overcome any challenge presented to him. The greater the chance of failure, the stronger he becomes.

item.name: The Compulsary
item.cardSummary: The Compulsary is a boss entry for Spirit Society Act 1 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Splits/Thrice makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: Heheheheheh!
item.description: The left hand of the spirit king, the vestiges of his power given form.

item.name: The Almighty
item.cardSummary: The Almighty is a boss entry for Spirit Society Act 3 with catastrophic danger level. Its listed ability Temporary Invulnerability makes it more than a plain index target.
item.quote: All futures converge before me. No hope, no resistance—only the inevitable.

item.quote: For some men these are the most precious, but I believe beneath them there is something even more precious than these. They are driven to pursue it, and their pursuit is solely for their own sake, not another. One man’s dream can hold dominion over the entire world, for one who dedicates his life to the forging of a single sword. While many can pursue their dreams in solitude, other dreams are like great storms blowing hundreds even thousands of dreams apart in their wake. Dreams breathe life into men, and can cage them in suffering. Men live and die by their dreams, but long after they’ve been abandoned, they still smolder deep in men’s hearts. Some see nothing more than life and death. They are dead. For they have no dreams.

item.name: Tui
item.mechanicsSummary: Stun duration: Permanent; Targets: In Range

item.quote: Don't tell me you actually think you can defeat me. I have no more use for you, goodbye.
item.description: Well aware of his great power, he was incredibly authoritarian and cruel, having no qualms about abusing others or killing members of his own 'family' by stringing them up and leaving them to be burned by the sun when they go against his wishes.

item.name: Demon Father

item.quote: I'll squeeze you to a pulp kid.
item.description: Father was animalistic, aggressive and extremely bloodthirsty. He was shown to be very devoted to his 'family'

item.name: Demon Mother

item.quote: Now then, my sweet little dolls.. dance until your arms and legs fall off.
item.description: Like most demons, Mother was cruel, unfeeling, and murderous towards humans. She ruthlessly controlled dozens of slayers through her threads and manipulated them into killing each other
